{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop QA orders
sales_clean = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders
completed_orders = sales_clean[sales_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of completed orders in each channel
completed_orders['channel'].value_counts()"}
